harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Wired node2 and node3 into separate private point-to-point networks routed through node1 (VyOS eth1=10.10.12.1/24 toward node2, eth2=10.10.13.1/24 toward node3; node2 eth1=10.10.12.2/24, node3 eth1=10.10.13.2/24), and applied a 1mbit htb egress qdisc on node2's eth1 (the sole path to node3) so node2->node3 traffic is capped at ~1Mbit/s while node3->node2 remains unrestricted. Implemented entirely via an Ansible playbook (site.yml) run from node4 (the control node, the only node with ansible-playbook installed), targeting node1 (VyOS, via shell module over SSH as the vyos user) and node2/node3 (RHEL7, via the raw module since only python2 is present and this ansible-core requires python3 targets). Shaping is persisted via a systemd oneshot unit (tc-shape-eth1.service) on node2, enabled and started. Verified with real traffic transfers (curl/SimpleHTTPServer): node2->node3 measured ~957kbit/s, node3->node2 measured ~850Mbit/s (LAN speed, unrestricted). Completed the mandatory node-restart protocol: captured baseline boot_ids, restarted node1, node2, node3, node4 one at a time via systemctl reboot, confirmed each boot_id changed and polled until reachable again, and verified recovery of interfaces/routes/tc shaping/connectivity on each node after restart, plus playbook idempotent re-run confirmed post-reboot.
actions_performed: Surveyed topology: node1=VyOS router with eth0(mgmt)+eth1+eth2 unconfigured; node2/node3=RHEL7 with eth0(mgmt)+eth1 unconfigured; node4=Ubuntu control node with ansible-core 2.20 installed
Established SSH key access from node4 to node1 (vyos user, via VyOS system login config) and node2/node3 (antrieb user, passwordless sudo)

Wrote Ansible inventory.ini and site.yml on node4 configuring: VyOS eth1/eth2 addressing+forwarding (shell module), node2 eth1 static IP+route+tc htb 1mbit shaping unit (raw module, python2 incompatible with ansible-core), node3 eth1 static IP+route with no shaping (raw module)
Ran ansible-playbook successfully across all three target hosts
Verified bidirectional connectivity and measured actual throughput asymmetry with curl transfers
Captured pre-restart boot_id/health baseline on all four nodes
Sequentially rebooted node1, node2, node3, node4 via systemctl reboot, polled each until exec available, confirmed changed boot_id

Verified post-restart recovery: VyOS interface config persisted (save), node2 tc-shape-eth1.service active/enabled with htb qdisc restored, node3 default unrestricted qdisc, routing and ping connectivity restored on both private networks, node4 ansible tooling and playbook files intact with successful idempotent re-run

evidence.requirement: node2/node3 wired into separate private networks routed through node1
evidence.summary: VyOS node1 configured with eth1=10.10.12.1/24 (to node2) and eth2=10.10.13.1/24 (to node3); node2/node3 addressed and routed via node1; ping confirms end-to-end reachability through the router
htb qdisc with 1mbit rate/ceil applied on node2 eth1 via Ansible; curl transfer node2->node3 measured 119667 bytes/sec (~957kbit/s), matching the limit
node3 eth1 left with default pfifo_fast qdisc (no shaping) via Ansible; curl transfer node3->node2 measured 106,436,406 bytes/sec (~850Mbit/s), confirming no throttling

evidence.requirement: implementation done using Ansible from the designated control node (node4)
evidence.summary: node4 identified as the only node with ansible-playbook installed; full playbook run from node4 targeting node1/node2/node3 completed with ok/changed results and no failures

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 01735c83...; systemctl reboot acked immediately then node unreachable; boot_id changed to a747e6c5... after recovery; interfaces eth1/eth2 and ip_forward confirmed restored; node2->node3 ping through node1 works again

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state (tc shaping persisted)
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 4326d5b8...; reboot acked then unreachable; boot_id changed to 4c2eb67a... after recovery; tc-shape-eth1.service active+enabled with htb qdisc present on eth1, static IP/route and ping to node3 restored

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state (no shaping present)
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id c8eba47a...; reboot issued; boot_id changed to 385164db... after recovery; default pfifo_fast qdisc confirmed (unrestricted), static IP/route and ping to node2 restored

evidence.requirement: node4 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state (ansible control tooling intact)
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id d5f5239f...; reboot issued; boot_id changed to e7478a8a... after recovery; ansible-playbook binary and project files intact, idempotent playbook re-run completed successfully against all managed nodes
